notes: Single raw sample per task/revision; no repeat medians because 4096-env Cartpole took tens of minutes per sample in this Isaac Sim 6 pip environment.
Cartpole uses 4096 envs to match the provided launch shape. Ant and Humanoid use 128 envs after a 1024-env Ant attempt exposed a CUDA 13 NVRTC loader-path issue before JSON emission.
Remaining Ant/Humanoid runs include LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/nvidia/cu13/lib so PyTorch/Triton can find libnvrtc-builtins.so.13.0.
Task IDs are the names registered by this Isaac Lab checkout: without the older -v0 suffix.
